note: the gradient dither amplitude is 0, so a dithered dark ramp bands like an undithered one, caught by GradientDitherTests.breaksBanding
the gradient dither matrix is indexed by x only, so every row repeats the first and a column never varies, caught by GradientDitherTests.usesBothAxes
the gradient dither shifts alpha as well as the colour, so a half-transparent dithered pixel changes its alpha, caught by GradientDitherTests.semiTransparentKeepsStraightColour
anchor: let out = RGBA(r: shift(s.r), g: shift(s.g), b: shift(s.b), a: s.a)
replacement: let out = RGBA(r: shift(s.r), g: shift(s.g), b: shift(s.b), a: shift(s.a))

note: the gradient dither's transfer table drops its lerp between entries, so the dithered encode is off by up to a fifth of a step, caught by GradientDitherTests
